# SD18 deterministic Human Monk level 12 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1..level-11 martial chassis baseline (tests/sd18_monk_level11_diamond_body.rs)
# to level 12 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1 through level-11
# fixtures, adding only the level bump this slice needs.
#
# The PF1 CRB Monk class table's level-12 "Special" column reads "Abundant
# step, slow fall 60 ft." (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and
# the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com mirror). Slow Fall's own reach magnitude
# genuinely rises from 50 ft to 60 ft via the same grant-only identity
# record already grounded at levels 4/6/8/10. Abundant Step is checked and
# confirmed NOT flat this slice (it requires both a ki-point-spending
# action-economy engine and a dimension-door-equivalent
# teleportation-resolution engine, neither of which exists anywhere in this
# codebase — mirroring the Wholeness of Body / High Jump precedent), so it
# is deliberately left named-but-unproven, not fabricated. It deliberately
# avoids every later Monk burden surface: no execution of what the
# recognized bonus feat actually does, no repeat bonus-feat grant
# recognition, no ki-power execution, no ki-strike
# damage-reduction-bypass resolution, no fall-damage engine, no High Jump,
# no Wholeness of Body execution, no Abundant Step execution, and no
# level-13+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level12
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:12
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:deflect_arrows
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/core-roster-and-support-state-matrix.md
